# X1: a call to a name that was never declared is refused by `check`, with the
# same words the runtime would use.
! exec metagente check a.ag
stderr 'does not know anything called `Other`'
stderr 'Found 1 problem\.'

-- a.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  accepts go
  on go
    r = Other.ask city: "x"
    reply r
